response.rationale: Systemic sclerosis is strongly supported by skin thickening, salt-and-pepper lesions, Raynaud phenomenon, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, and capillaroscopy late avascular changes. Other candidates lack this combination of specific features.

rejected.why: Arthritis and morning stiffness are nonspecific; no typical erosive joint findings or rheumatoid factor.
Ocular dryness and Schirmer test are present but do not explain skin thickening, Raynaud, or lung fibrosis.
Weak anti-Sm and ANA are insufficient; no classic lupus rash, renal, or hematologic criteria.
Overlap features exist but anti-U1RNP is not provided; systemic sclerosis features dominate.
